name: Dirección de Desenfoque de Movimiento
algorithm: Motion Blur Direction — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes motion blur direction consistency for video forensic detection:

1. **Movimiento Blur Detección**: Blurred regions in each frame are identified by analyzing the directional spread of the local point spread function (PSF). Motion-blurred regions show characteristic elongated PSFs in the direction of motion.

2. **Blur Direction Estimación**: For each blurred region, the blur direction and magnitude are estimated. Natural motion blur direction should be consistent with the object's motion vector between adjacent frames — blur direction aligns with the displacement vector.

3. **Global - Local Blur Consistencia**: Camera motion produces globally coherent blur (all objects blur in the same direction, adjusted for depth). Object motion produces local blur. The method verifies that the observed blur field is consistent with a combination of camera and object motion. Composited or generated content may show inconsistent blur directions between regions.

4. **Rostro - Background Blur Coherencia**: When camera motion occurs, the face and background should show consistent motion blur. Deepfake composites may show the face with different blur than the background — either sharper (generated without blur accounting) or blurred differently (incorrect motion estimation).

5. **Temporal Blur Continuity**: Motion blur should vary smoothly across frames — increasing with faster motion, decreasing with slower motion. The method tracks blur magnitude and direction temporally. Abrupt changes in blur characteristics without corresponding motion changes indicate manipulation or generation artifacts.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante motion blur direction analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Amerini, I. et al. (2019). Deepfake Video Detection through Optical Flow based CNN. ICCV Workshop.
Zheng, Y. et al. (2021). Exploring Temporal Coherence for More General Video Face Forgery Detection. ICCV.
